Callum Osmand scored twice in his first start for Celtic, and the 7-1 rout of Hearts on 18 October is the one result in this stretch that does not read like a warning. Across those five games Celtic have scored 11 and conceded 9, averages of 2.2 and 1.8 a match, with one clean sheet and one game without a goal.
